label: Plotly
help: This utility allows you to enter Plotly JSON and see the plotted output

fields.label: Input style
fields.help: Standard Plotly JSON typically separated data, layout and config, GenApp uses a combined style with a single JSON object containing data, layout and config values
fields.values: Separate data and layout inputs (no config supported)~separate~Combined data, layout and config input~combined

fields.label: Combined JSON
fields.help: Paste your combined GenApp style Plotly JSON here
enter the JSON with top level fields for data (required) and layout (optional)

fields.label: data JSON
fields.help: Paste your Plotly JSON data here
enter the JSON for the data (required)

fields.label: layout JSON
fields.help: Paste your Plotly JSON layout here
enter the JSON for the layout (optional)
